description: Electricity – Imports and Exports is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Canada Energy Regulator | La Régie de l’énergie du Canada. Companies importing and exporting electricity hold regulatory authorization from the CER and are required to report their export/import activities each month. Generated electricity not consumed domestically is exported. Electricity trade with United States is affected by prices, weather, power-line infrastructure and regional supply and demand. All these cause trade to vary from year to year. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Canada Energy Regulator | La Régie de l’énergie du Canada. Its tags are electricity, imports, exports, CER, NEB. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-02 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
